about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Night” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that we who rejoice to take part in the mysteries of the Nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ may by worthy lives merit to attain fellowship with Him, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
